title: Caramelized Butternut Squash Soup
description: Caramelized butternut squash soup recipe includes sweet honey, and a touch of nutmeg for extra flavor in this delicious puréed soup made with heavy cream.
ingredients: 3 pounds butternut squash, peeled and cubed
4 cups chicken broth, or more as needed
1 pinch ground nutmeg, or more to taste

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large pot over high heat. Add squash; cook and stir until completely browned, about 10 minutes. Add onion, butter, 1 tablespoon sea salt, and 1 teaspoon white pepper; cook and stir until onion is completely tender and beginning to brown, about 10 minutes.
Add chicken broth and honey; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low; simmer until squash is tender, about 5 minutes.
Fill blender halfway with soup. Cover and hold lid down with a potholder; pulse a few times before leaving on to blend. Pour into a pot. Repeat with remaining soup.
Stir cream and nutmeg into puréed soup until well blended; season with sea salt and white pepper.
